items.description: filing a new record for a (sku, location) pair with no existing row lands on a confirmation showing the saved sku, location, quantity, and inventory_code
a previously filed record is read back later showing the same stored sku, location, quantity, and inventory_code that were filed
refiling an existing (sku, location) pair with new quantity and tracking code leaves exactly one record for that pair holding the newly filed values
refiling an existing (sku, location) pair returns a 2xx confirmation for that pair with no error page shown
the routes/boundary module does not import the DB session; persistence is only in the repository (layering contract)
only the repository module issues ORM/session calls against stock_records; the service and boundary never touch the ORM directly (ORM-only persistence)
the app and Alembic env read the DB connection string from the injected DATABASE_URL and connect to databricks_postgres on the paired branch, with no hardcoded DSN (config-in-env)
submitting an invalid filing (e.g. negative quantity) returns a field-named inline error identifying the offending field, not a generic 400 body

inserting a stock_records row directly with a null sku, location, quantity, or inventory_code is rejected by the migration's NOT NULL constraints, and the repository round-trips all four fields intact on a valid row
inserting a stock_records row directly with a negative quantity raises a CHECK-constraint violation against the branch DB (verifies the migration realized the non-negative floor)
inserting two stock_records rows with the same (sku, location) directly raises a unique-constraint violation against the branch DB (verifies the migration realized PI1, backing the service's upsert)

the Alembic migration creating stock_records applies and, via a single-step downgrade then upgrade on an isolated migration branch, reverses and reapplies cleanly with pre-existing seeded rows surviving
